name: Yamuna Expressway Industrial Development Authority
summary: The authority that oversees the Yamuna Expressway and plans the new city growing along it around Jewar airport.
aka: Taj Expressway Industrial Development Authority (original name)
about: YEIDA was created to oversee the expressway from Greater Noida to Agra and to develop the land along it. It started life as the Taj Expressway Industrial Development Authority, the name the project carried when it was conceived in 2003, and was renamed once the road became the Yamuna Expressway. Beyond the road itself, it plans and sells the industrial and residential land beside it, which is how the whole project was paid for. The opening of Noida International Airport at Jewar in 2026 has made its area one of the fastest-growing in north India.
facts: Oversees the Yamuna Expressway, which opened in 2012.
Plans the townships and industrial land along the expressway, including around Jewar airport.
The road was built by a private company in exchange for toll rights and land, not cash.
